name: com.andreporsch/scorecards
title: André Porsch Self-check Briefs
description: Create answer briefs from André Porsch’s German and English AI-at-work self-check questions.

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: List André Porsch’s two public AI-at-work self-checks and their question snapshot date.

language.description: Filter by language: de for German or en for English. Omit to list both.

tools.name: get_assessment_questions
tools.description: Get the exact 12 questions and allowed answer choices in one language. Ask the person to choose. This is a dated snapshot, not a live ScoreApp session.

assessmentId.description: Assessment ID from list_assessments: ki-im-arbeitsalltag for German or ai-at-work for English.

tools.name: create_assessment_brief
tools.description: Validate all 12 answers and create a structured brief plus Markdown document. Group the nine practice answers and identify the person’s own partial, negative, and uncertain responses. No scoring, ranking, submission, email, or account access. Provide only answers the person actually chose; show the resulting brief to them.

assessmentId.description: Assessment ID from list_assessments: ki-im-arbeitsalltag for German or ai-at-work for English.

revision.description: Copy the revision returned by get_assessment_questions for the questions the person answered.

questionId.description: Copy the id of this question from the selected assessment’s questions array.

optionId.description: Copy the id of the option the person chose from this question’s options array.

answers.description: Supply one selected answer for each of the 12 distinct questions from the same assessment and revision.
